title: Approval survives an api service restart and re-read of persisted state
purpose: Verify that an approval recorded through the endpoint is still present in persisted state after the api service is fully restarted, which is the direct promise of AC-APPROVAL-002.
rationale: Every prior approve request timed out; even once responsive, durability across a restart is the load-bearing behavior in AC-APPROVAL-002 and is not covered by the in-session persistence scenario.
expected_observations: POST /approve returns 200 and the invoice is recorded approved before restart
After the api service restart, re-reading persisted state still shows W2R1 as approved
forbidden_observations: W2R1 shows pending or missing after restart
Persisted state loses the approval record after restart
isolation_note: Uses a scenario-unique invoice id (W2R1) that no other scenario touches; no shared row is mutated so it cannot contaminate concurrent scenarios. No approved command can delete state, so isolation is by unique id rather than teardown.

title: Two simultaneous approvals of the same invoice record a single durable approval
purpose: Exercise a race: issue two approve requests for the same invoice at the same instant and confirm persisted state holds exactly one approval, not a duplicated or inconsistent record.
rationale: Idempotency was only checked as sequential double-approve; a genuine simultaneous race can still double-write durable state and is untested.
expected_observations: Both concurrent requests complete without error
Persisted state shows W2R2 approved exactly once with no duplicate or conflicting record
forbidden_observations: State shows two separate approval records for W2R2
State shows an error/duplicate marker for W2R2
isolation_note: Contends only on scenario-unique invoice id W2R2; must not run concurrently with other scenarios touching the same id, which none do.

title: Approving a non-existent invoice does not record a spurious approval
purpose: Confirm that POSTing an approval for an invoice id that was never created does not durably persist an approved record for it.
rationale: AC-APPROVAL-001 scopes durability to approving an invoice; approving something that is not an invoice should not fabricate durable state.
expected_observations: The endpoint rejects approval of an unknown invoice (non-2xx)
No approved record exists for W2R3-NOPE in persisted state
forbidden_observations: Persisted state contains an approved record for the unknown invoice
The endpoint returns 200 for a non-existent invoice
isolation_note: References a never-created id W2R3-NOPE; a correct implementation writes nothing, so there is nothing to clean up.

title: Re-approving after a restart keeps a single durable approval
purpose: After an approval survives a restart, re-issue the same approval and confirm persisted state still reflects a single approval rather than a second record.
rationale: Combines re-read-after-restart with a repeated request to ensure idempotency holds across the persistence boundary, not just within one process lifetime.
expected_observations: Re-approving after restart leaves exactly one durable approval for W2R4
forbidden_observations: A second/duplicate approval record appears for W2R4 after re-approval
State reverts to pending after the second approval
isolation_note: Uses scenario-unique invoice id W2R4; no other scenario references it.
